Course Content Management: [HIGH PRIORITY / CRIT-02] Marking ANOTHER user's lesson complete succeeds by just changing the userId query param
column3: 1. Log in as User A, obtain token. 2. PUT /api/v1/lessons/{id}/complete?userId=<User B's id>&completed=true using User A's token (or no token at all). 3. As User B, GET /api/v1/lessons/{id} to confirm B's isCompleted flag actually changed.
column4: 200 OK — the request succeeds and mutates User B's progress data even though it was made using User A's identity (or anonymously) — userId is trusted from the query string with no cross-check.
column5: Two distinct user accounts, A and B; a lesson both could plausibly access.
column6: Yes — 🔍 confirm in Network tab whether an Authorization header for A (or none at all) was sent, and that the call still returned 200.
column17: CRIT-02 (AUDIT_REPORT.md). This is the actual exploit, not a hypothetical — do not soften the Expected Result; a 200 here IS the confirmed bug.
